title: 성격 이야기: 친절해요? 게을러요?
objective: By the end, you can describe yourself or someone you know with words like 부지런하다, 게으르다, 성실하다 and 친절하다, and talk about a strength or weakness in a short sentence.
summary: Ten words for describing what people are like, such as hard-working, lazy, kind and impatient, plus words for strengths and weaknesses.

task.title: Use the personality words
task.line: Read each short situation and choose or write the word from this worksheet that fits best.

words.meaning: personality, character (what a person is like)
words.exampleMeaning: My older sister has a cheerful personality.

words.meaning: a special feature, what makes something stand out
words.exampleMeaning: What this restaurant is known for is its spicy food.

words.meaning: hard-working, active, gets things done early
words.exampleMeaning: My father is hard-working, so he gets up at six every day.
On weekends I'm lazy, so I don't clean.

words.meaning: reliable and diligent, always doing what one should
words.example: 민수 씨는 성실해서 회사에 한 번도 안 늦었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Minsu is so reliable that he has never once been late for work.

words.example: 지나 씨는 친절해서 길을 잘 알려 줘요.
words.exampleMeaning: Jina is kind, so she gladly shows people the way.

words.example: 저는 성격이 급해서 기다리는 것을 싫어해요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm impatient, so I hate waiting.
My younger sibling is outgoing, so he has many friends.
In the interview, they asked about my strengths.

words.example: 제 단점은 약속 시간을 잘 안 지키는 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: My weakness is that I'm often late for appointments.

exercises: Choose the right word: 동생은 한 달 동안 방 청소를 안 했어요. 정말 (부지런해요 / 게을러요).
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 하나 씨는 길을 모르는 사람에게 학교까지 같이 가 줘요. 정말 ____.
Which word describes each person? Choose from 부지런하다, 급하다, 활발하다: ① 매일 아침 5시에 일어나서 운동해요. ② 엘리베이터가 안 오면 바로 계단으로 가요. ③ 모임에서 먼저 말하고 친구를 많이 사귀어요.
Fill in the blank with 장점 or 단점: ① 제 ____은 친구가 많은 거예요. ② 이 집의 ____은 역에서 너무 먼 거예요.
Fill in the blank with 성격 or 특징: ① 제 남자 친구는 ____이 조용해요. ② 이 카메라의 ____은 아주 작고 가벼운 거예요.
Fill in the blank: 리나 씨는 5년 동안 수업에 한 번도 안 빠졌어요. 정말 ____.
answers: ① 부지런하다 ② 급하다 ③ 활발하다
